methodology: Fresh process for every invocation; warmed filesystem cache; alternating baseline/candidate order; no incremental cache; typechecking enabled; timings include process startup and diagnostic output capture. All measured commands must match the approved exit code and diagnostics; nonzero semantic diagnostics require an explicit manifest fingerprint. GNU time wraps both compilers for discovery, preflight, warmups and samples. Wrapped wall times include wrapper launch/wait and resource-file output and are not comparable to historical unwrapped timings. Temporary-directory setup, resource parsing and cleanup are outside the timer; RSS is recorded separately from diagnostic output.
